c74object.name: lp.loggie
c74object.description: lp.loggie generates random numbers from a logistic distribution.

objarg.name: seed
objarg.digest: Seed for the random number generator (0, the default, seeds automatically)

method.name: float
method.description: In the left inlet: Map a value between 0 and 1 through the distribution (instead of a random number) and output the result. In the 2nd inlet: alpha. In the 3rd inlet: beta.

method.name: seed
method.digest: Reseed the random number generator (0 seeds automatically)
method.description: Reseed the random number generator (0 seeds automatically).

method.description: Send an attribute value to a receive object: tell <receive name> <attribute>.
